say:1:1610314001:1.text: All are present. Excellent. Now, hush. I ask for silence... a silence fit for a graveyard.
say:1:1610314001:1.source_cn: 人都齐了，很好，现在闭上你们的嘴。我希望这里和深夜的墓...

say:2:1610314002:1.text: Gaze now upon yourselves, my beloved and brazen students... Each and every one of you is a dawn-star dazzlingly lit by the Serene Lyceum!
say:2:1610314002:1.source_cn: 看看呐……看看你们，我可爱又危险的学生……你们全都是莱...

say:3:1610314003:1.text: If all of you were to become court mages, the very stones of the palace would gleam with the radiance of your talents!
say:3:1610314003:1.source_cn: 如果你们全都能成为宫廷魔法师，王宫的地板都要因为你们的...

say:4:1610314004:1.text: I once put this proposal to Cyran with the utmost seriousness. I recall he was attempting to fish from a well at the time, but he heard me and said the royal court must consider their budget. Isn't that right, Cyran?
say:4:1610314004:1.source_cn: 我把这个提议郑重其事地告诉迪尔格雷，他当时正试图从井里...

say:7:1610314006:1.text: Give everyone a smile. You don't need to be so serious all the time.

say:8:1610314007:1.text: I think it's time to get to the point, Headmaster Leymar.
say:8:1610314007:1.source_cn: 我想，可以尽快说重点了，雷蒙校长。

choice_prompt:9:1610314007.text: I think it's time to get to the point, Headmaster Leymar.
choice_prompt:9:1610314007.source_cn: 我想，可以尽快说重点了，雷蒙校长。

say:10:1610314008:3.text: You know the Chief Court Mage?
say:10:1610314008:3.source_cn: 你们认识？那可是首席宫廷魔法师。
say:10:1610314008:3.male: You know the Chief Court Mage?
say:10:1610314008:3.female: You know the Chief Court Mage?

choice_prompt:11:1610314008.text: You know the Chief Court Mage?
choice_prompt:11:1610314008.source_cn: 你们认识？那可是首席宫廷魔法师。
choice_prompt:11:1610314008.male: You know the Chief Court Mage?
choice_prompt:11:1610314008.female: You know the Chief Court Mage?

say:12:1610314009:1.text: Is there a hidden story here?
say:12:1610314009:1.male: Is there a hidden story here?
say:12:1610314009:1.female: Is there a hidden story here?

say:13:1610314011:1.text: Anyway, everyone knows that Magister Cyran studied in the Lyceum with Magister Merlin himself.
say:13:1610314011:1.source_cn: 我只知道迪尔格雷大人曾和梅林大人一同在莱希拉姆读书。
say:13:1610314011:1.male: Anyway, everyone knows that Magister Cyran studied in the Lyceum with Magister Merlin himself.
say:13:1610314011:1.female: Anyway, everyone knows that Magister Cyran studied in the Lyceum with Magister Merlin herself.

say:14:1610314012:1.text: So I was digging through the library's old exam records, and get this... He always placed second, right after Merlin.
say:14:1610314012:1.source_cn: 我在图书馆查过以前的考试排名，他好像每次都排在梅林大人后面。
say:14:1610314012:1.male: So I was digging through the library's old exam records, and get this... He always placed second, right after Merlin.
say:14:1610314012:1.female: So I was digging through the library's old exam records, and get this... He always placed second, right after Merlin.

say:15:1610314013:1.text: It seems like they were friends and rivals, like Cassadee and Gervan.
say:15:1610314013:1.source_cn: 他们好像是有着竞争关系的朋友，就像科丝蒂和格墨文。
say:15:1610314013:1.male: It seems like they were friends and rivals, like Cassadee and Gervan.
say:15:1610314013:1.female: It seems like they were friends and rivals, like Cassadee and Gervan.

say:16:1610314014:1.text: But of course, only our dear Headmaster Leymar would have the guts to tease Magister Cyran at a time like this. The look on his face just now was absolutely priceless!
say:16:1610314014:1.source_cn: 不过，也只有雷蒙校长敢在这种场合跟迪尔格雷开玩笑了。他...
say:16:1610314014:1.male: But of course, only our dear Headmaster Leymar would have the guts to tease Magister Cyran at a time like this. The look on his face just now was absolutely priceless!
say:16:1610314014:1.female: But of course, only our dear Headmaster Leymar would have the guts to tease Magister Cyran at a time like this. The look on his face just now was absolutely priceless!

say:18:1610314015:1.text: Don't compare me to Magister Merlin... That's impossible...
say:18:1610314015:1.source_cn: 我我我……我可没法和梅林大人比……
say:18:1610314015:1.male: Don't compare me to Magister Merlin... That's impossible...
say:18:1610314015:1.female: Don't compare me to Magister Merlin... That's impossible...

say:19:1610314016:1.text: My accomplishments are hardly enough to compare me to Magister Cyran.
say:19:1610314016:1.source_cn: 我的造诣，也不配和迪尔格雷大人相提并论。

say:21:1610314017:1.text: Everyone, prick up your ears and listen well. I'm about to make an announcement...
say:21:1610314017:1.source_cn: 大家都竖起耳朵听好了。我将宣布一条重要消息：

say:22:1610314018:1.text: The preliminary screening for this year's court mage selection will begin today at <style="highlight">two o'clock in the afternoon</style>, precisely!
say:22:1610314018:1.source_cn: 本次宫廷魔法师选拔初筛将于<style=highlig...

say:23:1610314019:1.text: Only students who successfully pass this preliminary screening can officially participate in the selection exam.
say:23:1610314019:1.source_cn: 顺利通过初筛的学生，方能正式参加选拔赛。

say:24:1610314020:1.text: The student who earns <style="highlight">first place</style> in the selection will be appointed as a court mage. The Chief Court Mage, <style="highlight">Magister Cyran</style>, will personally present the letter of appointment to the winner.

say:26:1610314022:1.text: Headmaster Leymar's parting glance tells you Zorya is controlling his body. Remember, the true goal of this trial is to uncover who killed the headmaster.
say:26:1610314022:1.source_cn: 雷蒙校长离开前向你投来了一个眼神，你意识到是佐尔娅老师...
say:26:1610314022:1.male: Headmaster Leymar's parting glance tells you Zorya is controlling his body. Remember, the true goal of this trial is to uncover who killed the headmaster.
say:26:1610314022:1.female: Headmaster Leymar's parting glance tells you Zorya is controlling his body. Remember, the true goal of this trial is to uncover who killed the headmaster.

say:28:1610314010:1.text: Are you for real? What does that mean...?
say:28:1610314010:1.male: Are you for real? What does that mean...?
say:28:1610314010:1.female: Are you for real? What does that mean...?

choice:11:1:2.text: Let's just say I know he has soft hands.
choice:11:1:2.male: Let's just say I know he has soft hands.
choice:11:1:2.female: Let's just say I know he has soft hands.
